title: NFCorpus personal workflow validation
scope: AI-assisted personal workflow validation on previously explored public data. Separate from the archived r2 agent trajectories; not a new blind benchmark or evidence of agent superiority.
participation: The applicant confirmed commands and selection logic; AI assisted command preparation, candidate-file writing and record organization.
selection_rule: Highest development nDCG@10; earliest trial on ties.
validation_notes: Invalid weight was rejected before state creation or budget use.
Six distinct successful development trials were recorded before selection.
Weight 0.85 is best only among these six evaluated candidates; no global-peak claim.
The shared baseline k=60 and weight=0.5 also appears in the archived agent trajectories.
Private terminal transcripts and personal notes are not included in this public summary.

docker_audit.scope: Archived-trace verification and an automatic synthetic fixture demo, separate from the NFCorpus run.
